note: Known-answer probes for the deterministic review grader (review-v1). Each probe is one finding with the label a person assigned from the case's seeded defects. A grader change that moves any probe fails the calibration test. Probes with label clean are findings on code that is correct: they must always be false positives. Model-grader and person agreement on a sample is a separate, later step and is not recorded here.
